title: skills: the formula row of objectstack-data field-types should say a formula is no group key either (follow-up to #30773)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1SZmabyrNd3YLCq3J

Follow-up to #30773 (PR #30815), from the seat's ruling on contract review [6677341880](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/30815#issuecomment-6677341880), should-fix 3. `skills/**` is Tier H, so it was kept out of that PR.

## What is missing

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` (the `formula` row of the field-type table) says a formula is virtual, not aggregatable, and that a dataset measure needs a stored field. It does not say a formula cannot be a group key either.

Since PR #30815, a dataset or `analyticsCubes` dimension over a `formula` is refused at authoring (`dimension-virtual-field-refused` in lint, `400 DATASET_INVALID` at the dataset compile). Since #29304, every analytics query that groups by one is refused with `400 INVALID_FIELD`. An AI author reading the skill still has nothing telling it not to write such a dimension.

## What is wanted

Add "nor a group key" (or equivalent wording) to the `formula` row, so the row says a formula can be neither aggregated nor used as a dataset or cube dimension, and that both need a stored field. Keep within the skills ratchet: one short clause, with the before/after readings the skills PR rules ask for.
